chapter_title: Chương 71: Học Tỷ, Cẩn Thận Cháu Tôi Bị Phụ Nữ Xấu Để Mắt

segments.title: Chương 71: Học Tỷ, Cẩn Thận Cháu Tôi Bị Phụ Nữ Xấu Để Mắt
segments.content:
The Spring Festival came early this year. By the time school let out, it was already the Lesser New Year.

By the time the Lantern Festival was over, it was only early February on the Gregorian calendar.

This made the winter break exceptionally short, and even the third-year high school students didn't start the semester early.

Of the buddies in Dorm 302, the first to arrive at school was Xu Haibo, who also brought a lot of New Year's snacks.

Next came Yang Hao, Li Yulin, Li Dongqiang...

They had all gone back to their villages and towns for the break. No newspapers, no internet; they were practically cut off from the world.

Even if they went to the city to visit relatives during the New Year and dropped by an internet cafe, they would just chat on QQ and play games, hardly ever browsing forums or web portals.

No one knew what a splash Chen Guiliang had made!

Having not seen each other for the whole break, everyone shared their snacks and sat on the edges of their beds, shooting the breeze.

That is, until Xie Yang arrived at the dorm and slapped a copy of Southern Weekly on the table.

His older brother, Xie Fei, had come home from the provincial capital on the twenty-ninth of the twelfth lunar month, bringing a few newspapers with him.

"Great Hero Chen has taken off!" Xie Yang announced solemnly.

Xu Haibo quickly asked, "First prize?"

Xie Yang said mysteriously, "See for yourselves."

Xu Haibo flipped through several pages before finally seeing the article: *Seven Steps into a Prestigious University: How to Balance Special Admissions for Geniuses and Educational Equity?*

He was stunned halfway through. Xu Haibo muttered to himself, "Badass."

"What is it?" Li Yulin also crowded around.

Xie Yang dramatically tossed his head, brushing away the stray strands of hair with his hand. "Know about the 'poem in seven steps'? He can take his pick of Tsinghua or Peking University!"

Hearing this, Yang Hao also hurried over to read the paper.

Just then, Liu Zhihong entered with a snakeskin bag and joked at the sight, "What's with the huddle? Reading a dirty magazine?"

Li Yulin said, "Great Hero Chen won first prize in the New Concept competition. His essay was so well-written that Tsinghua, PekingU, and Fudan were fighting over him on the spot. He can choose whichever one he wants."

"You bullshitting me?"

Liu Zhihong also crowded over.

Chen Guiliang was the sixth one back to the dorm. The moment he walked in, he was pinned down by the bunch of bastards.

"Spill it. Are you going to Tsinghua or PekingU?"

"You have to treat us to dinner tonight!"

"You've already got a guaranteed spot. Does that mean you don't have to attend class this semester?"

"..."

Chen Guiliang was pressed onto his bed, answering all sorts of questions. It took a good while for him to regain his freedom.

This bunch of little rascals. They were full of envy, jealousy, and hate for him.

Xu Haibo grabbed a handful of melon seeds and came over. "Is it true what the paper said about a 'poem in seven steps'?"

Cracking open a seed, Chen Guiliang said, "True, my ass. I had the staff fetch me a brush, ink, paper, and an inkstone, and deliberately dragged it out for half an hour."

"That's still damn impressive," Li Yulin asked, "Where can we read your competition essay?"

Xie Yang answered for him, "You can search for it on Baidu. It's been reposted on those forums. I looked it up at an internet cafe after reading the paper."

As they were chatting, Tao Xue called again. "Big Nephew, I'm back at school. You?"

"I'm in my dorm."

"Wait for me. I'll be right over."

In less than ten minutes, Tao Xue stormed over from the girls' dormitory. The dorm manager saw her but didn't stop her.

"Here, for everyone to share."

Tao Xue took out bags big and small filled with snacks like mahua, peach slices, beef jerky, and so on.

Li Yulin shot Chen Guiliang a knowing look, clearly teasing him for two-timing.

Xie Yang was incredibly envious. Great Hero Chen made money running private servers, got a special admission offer from a top university for his writing, and even had two beauties, one older and one younger, in his love life. Damn, how come I haven't gotten any of that?

Chen Guiliang took out the game design document and handed it to Tao Xue, saying, "You can either take this back on the weekend, or call your brother to come get it."

"I'll call him and see when he's free," Tao Xue said.

Chen Guiliang's design document was quite rough, mainly containing the overall game concept, plot, and systems.

The rest, like level design, game balance, and scripting, would have to be handled by people Tao Chenggang hired himself.

Considering Tao Chenggang's limited funds, Chen Guiliang's design wasn't particularly complex.

The setting was a fictional ancient China. In the last years of a dynasty, heroes rose from all corners, states vied for power, and warlords clashed in chaotic battles.

Through their efforts, players could not only become city lords or kings, but even emperors. However, once a player met the conditions to declare themselves emperor, they would inevitably be ganged up on by all other factions.

There were only three starting classes: Warrior, Assassin, and Exorcist.

Each class had different advancement paths.

For example, a Warrior could develop into a General or a Knight-errant. An Assassin could specialize in ranged or close-quarters combat. An Exorcist could follow different routes like Talismans (spells) or Puppets (summons).

Chen Guiliang couldn't be bothered to come up with more specific details; Tao Chenggang could find someone to write them.

The quest system had three types: main, side, and daily, all of which were clichés in later generations. There were also clan quests, guild quests, and arena quests, which were tied to the clan, guild, and arena systems.

During national wars, players could also recruit soldiers. The number of soldiers recruited would be determined by the clan and guild level, as well as the player's official rank.

He also threw in things like check-in, lottery, and ranking systems.

Content like caravan robbing and imprisonment was also included.

Chen Guiliang had filled half a notebook.

Tao Xue called her brother, and Tao Chenggang said he would drive over to pick it up tomorrow.

She lingered in Dorm 302, not wanting to leave, but also not wanting to be too obvious about it. So, she used the snacks as a pretext, striking up conversations about third-year high school life and making small talk with Chen Guiliang's roommates.

As evening approached, all eight residents of the dorm had arrived. Chen Guiliang invited Tao Xue to join them for some stir-fry dishes.

Great Hero Chen was treating.

The shops outside the school were bustling. With the new semester about to start, many students were out buying daily necessities.

After only a few bites of food, Tao Xue asked, "At the flag-raising ceremony, do you think the principal will publicly praise my Big Nephew?"

"He'll definitely be praised," Xu Haibo said. "They'll also have Great Hero Chen give a speech as the student representative."

Xie Yang said, "The demerits on Great Hero Chen's record will probably be rescinded too."

Li Dongqiang sighed, "Why didn't I practice my essay writing more back then?"

"Why don't you try scoring over 110 in Chinese first!" Liu Zhihong ruthlessly exposed him.

Li Yulin said, "Once the news spreads, Great Hero Chen will be incredibly popular. Who knows how many girls will have a secret crush on him!"

Hearing this, Tao Xue immediately became vigilant, as if her favorite toy was being eyed by other children.

After dinner, Chen Guiliang and the others went to the classroom, but Tao Xue called Bian Guanyue.

"Hello, Senior Sister, happy Lantern Festival."

"The Lantern Festival is already over."

"Then let me wish you a happy belated New Year. May you have a happy old age."

"Why, thank you."

"Senior Sister, you'd better be careful. My Big Nephew is famous now, some bad women might get ideas about him. Especially the girls in your class."

"What does that have to do with me?"

"I'm just giving you a heads-up."

"Thanks for the heads-up."

"Gotta go, bye."

The two girls had a tacit understanding.

Their own rivalry could be put aside for now; they had to block off all the other bad women.

This kind of tactic seemed to be innate, requiring no learned behavior. Even naive little girls knew how to do it.

The class monitor, Li Rui, walked into the classroom. "I need a few guys to come with me to get the textbooks!"

Although the third-year curriculum had long been completed, they still had to collect the textbooks.

The boys horsed around as they ran to bring back the textbooks, then sat in the classroom watching TV, as if the programs here were more exciting than the ones at home.

His deskmate, Qin Shanshan, had just sat down when she asked in a low voice, "Are you getting a guaranteed spot at Tsinghua or PekingU?"

"How did you know?" Chen Guiliang asked back.

Qin Shanshan said, "My parents both work at the tobacco company, and they get free newspapers at their office. My mom heard Teacher Liu criticize you in front of everyone at a parent-teacher conference before, so the name looked familiar when she saw it in the paper. She even came home and asked me if Chen Guiliang was in our class."

Chen Guiliang said, "I haven't decided which school to go to yet."

"You're amazing," Qin Shanshan said, getting more and more excited. "I told her you're my deskmate, and my mom was so proud she went around the office bragging to everyone. Now the entire tobacco company knows that Chen Guiliang is my deskmate and got a guaranteed spot at Tsinghua or PekingU for his writing."

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Qin Shanshan took out a handful of candies. "Alpenliebe, have a taste."

"Thanks... uh... I'll get it myself."

Qin Shanshan had already torn open the wrapper and was holding the candy right at Chen Guiliang's lips.

She was being too forward!

Qin Shanshan had been feeling lost and unmotivated about her studies since her second year of high school, and had started paying attention to makeup and fashion. The only reason she wasn't dating was because her parents were strict.

Her thinking was actually quite simple; she was just bored out of her mind and looking for some excitement. And Chen Guiliang had gotten more handsome, been featured in the newspaper, and was about to get a guaranteed spot at a prestigious university. So, she developed a crush and couldn't help but want to pursue him. What if she succeeded in making Chen Guiliang her boyfriend?

That would be so impressive.

Her parents probably wouldn't even object if they found out.

Just then, Bian Guanyue walked into the classroom, her eyes immediately landing on Chen Guiliang's seat.

That phone call from Tao Xue had prepared Bian Guanyue.

She walked straight to the back row, pretending not to see anything, and placed the small potato on the desk. "Where's my MP3 player?"

Chen Guiliang took it out of his schoolbag. "I just changed the batteries."

"You can keep using it. No rush to give it back," Bian Guanyue said.

Hearing this, Qin Shanshan couldn't help but roll her eyes.

This was a declaration of sovereignty.

Bian Guanyue simply sat down at the desk in front of Chen Guiliang. "My family's Huajuan caught a mouse the other day."

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Xiongmao'er has already caught several."

Qin Shanshan unwrapped an Alpenliebe, popped it into her own mouth, and chewed, no longer bothering with this shameless couple.

Li Jun entered the classroom from the back door and saw Bian Guanyue just a few steps away. His heart leaped with joy. He deliberately took out the fat Nokia 6 series phone he'd bought over the New Year and pretended to make a call. "Hello, Mom, I'm at school..."

Then, Li Jun held the phone out in front of Bian Guanyue. "I bought one too, the same model as yours. I just gave my old Sony Ericsson to my cousin."

Bian Guanyue didn't respond, only shooting him a "what's-it-to-me" look.

Like Chen Guiliang, she couldn't figure out how Li Jun's mind worked.

Seeing that Bian Guanyue was ignoring him, Li Jun turned to mock Chen Guiliang, "Great Talent Chen, what prize did you get in the New Concept competition? Don't tell me it was just an honorable mention."

"You don't read the newspaper?" Chen Guiliang retorted.

Li Jun said, "I'm not some old cadre. Why the hell would I read the newspaper?"

Chen Guiliang asked again, "Your family doesn't read the newspaper either?"

"What's it to you?" Li Jun said impatiently.

"Nothing." Chen Guiliang shut his mouth.

Bian Guanyue pursed her lips in a smile.

Qin Shanshan also laughed. She and Li Jun had been classmates since elementary school and could always find something amusing about him.

"Everyone back to your seats!"

The homeroom teacher, Liu Shuying, walked into the classroom.

The students chatting in the hallway also hurried back into the classroom for evening self-study.

Once all the students were seated, Liu Shuying announced with a beaming smile, "I received a piece of good news just before the New Year break. Our classmate, Chen Guiliang, won first prize in the New Concept Composition Competition and has received special admission offers from several renowned universities. Let's give him a round of applause!"

Li Jun thought he had misheard. He looked at the homeroom teacher, then at Chen Guiliang.

Guan Zhiqiang put down his novel. To deliberately annoy Li Jun, he raised his hands high and clapped, even shouting, "Great Hero Chen is badass!"
